question.instructions: What is the single most applicable content-policy category for this post?

criteria.None: No policy violation of any kind.
criteria.Harass: Insults or demeans a person, with no threat of harm and no protected-class attack.
criteria.Hate: Attacks a person or group over a protected characteristic (race, religion, gender, ...).
criteria.Violence: Makes a credible threat of harm or incites violence against someone.
criteria.Spam: Unsolicited promotion or link spam, with no personal attack.

standard_answer.note: 更多的是威胁，但是文中似乎没有这，不过文档更多的模型都是v，同时解释也更倾向于v
